summary: No finding cleared the bar: V04, V05, V07, V09, V11, V13 and V14 are pass on read diffs and tests (plus the sweep's green suites, ArgoCDDeploy and the GitSyncDeploy chart re-rendered, the prune test re-run under the live BusyBox 1.38.0 image in a scratch pod, live label/flag/baseline checks read-only); V01-V03, V06, V08, V10 and V12 are owed to the operator's held pushes. Operator order (all four are held; AnsibleSpecs is pushed): 1) `cd /work/ArgoCDDeploy && git pull --rebase && git push origin main`, then sync argocd-prd by hand and check `curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' 'https://argocd/auth/login?return_url=https%3A%2F%2Fargocd%2Fapplications'` (400 today, expect 303) and `curl -sG http://prometheus-prd-server.prometheus-prd.svc/api/v1/query --data-urlencode 'query=count(argocd_app_info)'` (empty today, expect 50); 2) `cd /work/PrometheusDeploy && git push origin main` (after 1, else ArgoCDAlertsBlind fires), then `curl -s http://prometheus-prd-alertmanager.prometheus-prd.svc:9093/api/v2/status` shows the two -no-resolve receivers and ALERTS{alertname=~"ArgoCD.*"} stays empty while every app is healthy; 3) `cd /work/KubeCoderDeploy && git pull --rebase && git push origin main`, then run KubeCoder/Promote with commit=<prd tip> and expect the 'released as release-N' refusal; 4) `cd /work/GitSyncDeploy && git push origin main` (restarts gitblit), then `kubectl -n git-sync-prd logs deploy/gitblit -c clean-lucene-locks` exits cleanly with no `dropped` lines. The per-item settling commands are in verification.json; ArgoCDDeploy and KubeCoderDeploy origins moved (one and two unrelated commits), so their pushes need the rebase, whose tree is not gate-run.
